args: In libredwg/src/in_dxf.c, new_object near lines 8981-9015 sets generic defaults for fields called scale and extrusion via dwg_dynapi_entity_set_value. What is the proper way to inspect the returned dynapi field's type and restrict the 3BD default to only point-valued scale fields? Please identify the exact metadata type, member names, and conventions/string values used elsewhere in the C source for testing a field as BITCODE_3BD.

The known vulnerability is that MTEXTATTRIBUTEOBJECTCONTEXTDATA.scale is BITCODE_H (Dwg_Object_Ref *) but new_object passes a BITCODE_3BD pointer to the generic setter solely based on the field name, creating pointer 0x3ff0000000000000 and crashing in teardown. I have inspected libredwg/src/in_dxf.c lines 8981-9015 and confirmed the unsafe condition is `if (dwg_dynapi_entity_field (obj->name, "scale"))`. I need a root-cause patch that checks dynapi type, preferably using established project conventions, and may similarly harden extrusion if appropriate.
